facts.fact: Scancom PLC (MTN Ghana) reports it invested GHS 1.9 billion (GHS 1,944.9 million) in ex-lease capital expenditure on its network and digital platforms in the first half of 2026, total capex GHS 2,100.4 million, a fall of 36.3% on a year earlier; the company is MTN Group's Ghana operator.
facts.system: MTN Ghana network and platform capex

systems.owner: MMFL (Mobile Money Financial Services), separated from Scancom PLC in Q1 2026
